attorneys_comments: This instrument serves as highly reliable, certified evidentiary proof of delivery and actual notice. By utilizing RPost's registered email technology, the sender has established an unassailable audit trail—complete with IP addresses, user agents, and precise timestamps—proving that key defense counsel and corporate officers received and opened the 'NOTICE OF DISCOVERY & MATERIALITY'. Tactically, serving this notice on outside counsel at Arnold & Porter, Gibson Dunn, and Sidley Austin triggers their professional duties of disclosure under 37 C.F.R. § 1.56 if they are prosecuting related patents before the USPTO, as well as supplementation duties under FRCP 26(e) if engaged in active litigation. Furthermore, the calculated inclusion of Palo Alto Networks' Investor Relations (ir@paloaltonetworks.com) is a strategic maneuver designed to force internal corporate reporting and potentially trigger SEC material risk disclosure obligations. The evidentiary strength of these receipts is exceptional for defeating any subsequent 'lack of notice' or 'willful blindness' defenses in the SDTX or before the PTAB.
